_:
What a field key MEANS, for the model that is shown the key. `76` SS10.1 records the glossary decision as owed and names three options; the owner chose the second -- the dossier carries meanings, per call, for the fields of that call. Rule 2 of the `82` draft, which told the model to decline any key whose meaning is not plain from the key itself, is what this replaces: it was safe and it cost coverage on `subject`, `work_type`, `purpose`, `record_type`, `project` and `duplicate_family` -- the fields that matter most.

EVERY MEANING HERE IS TRANSCRIBED, NONE IS AUTHORED. A field's meaning is text that goes to a model, so it is close to prompt text, and prompt text is the owner's to ratify. Each entry quotes a source that already existed and names it; `tests/p8/test_p8_field_glossary.py` re-reads the source and fails if the quote is not there. A field whose meaning is recorded nowhere is in `owed`, gets no entry, and the model is told nothing about it -- which is `82` rule 2's fail-closed position, kept for exactly the fields that earned it.

A DEFINITION OF A FIELD, NEVER A HINT ABOUT A FILE. No entry may carry an example drawn from a person's corpus, may vary between two files, or may become a channel for anything in `privacy.vocabulary.ALWAYS_LOCAL`. The loader is given the allowed vocabulary and nothing else, which is what makes that structural rather than a promise.

owed.capture_date: No authored role sentence exists. `00` §3.2 gives the worked derivation (“an EXIF field called DateTimeOriginal is raw metadata”) and `60` mints no note for the key. Owed to the owner.

file_type.meaning: detected format family of the file; a routing signal, not a meaning

creation_date.meaning: filesystem/document creation timestamp of this file version

language.meaning: natural language(s) of the file's content

duplicate_family.meaning: membership in a family of byte-identical or perceptually near-identical copies

version_family.meaning: membership in a draft/revision family of one logical document

download_session.meaning: membership in a tightly bounded download session; a purpose clue and review aid only

authored_by.meaning: who authored or produced the file; metadata by design, never a collection point

target_school.meaning: the school a document is addressed to, in section-3.8's own spelling; same entity type as target_university, different provenance sentence

our_firm.meaning: the holder's own organization on an engagement; authorship-side identity, never a collection point

client.meaning: the counterparty organization an engagement serves - the target side of the our_firm split

school.meaning: the institution the holder attends, attended, or teaches at - the person's own school, never the application target

term.meaning: academic term or cycle the material belongs to

subject.meaning: the course or study subject the material belongs to

instructor.meaning: the person teaching the course; a search/review field, not a folder level

work_type.meaning: if the file IS the work product of a bounded engagement or course -> `work_type`

target_university.meaning: the institution an application is addressed TO - never the holder's own school

application_cycle.meaning: the admissions cycle an application belongs to

application_document_type.meaning: what role a document plays inside an application (essay, transcript, form, portal record); members are values, never roster nodes

purpose.meaning: what the file was FOR, as opposed to what it is about

project.meaning: the named project a file belongs to; shared by the research and code schemas (shares_field is derived from this shared reference, never authored)

stage.meaning: where in its workflow a research artifact sits

artifact_type.meaning: if it is an OUTPUT OF A MAKING PROCESS -> `artifact_type`

lab.meaning: the lab or research group the work belongs to

venue.meaning: the journal, conference, or publication venue an artifact targets or appeared in

institution.meaning: the financial or record-issuing institution a record belongs to

account_type.meaning: the kind of account a financial record belongs to

tax_year.meaning: the tax year a financial record belongs to

record_type.meaning: `record_type` is what remains: the file evidences that a transaction, operation or decision occurred. Where two readings are both supported, `00` requires abstention, not the nearest declared key.

account_holder.meaning: The holder is a person or entity identity, so it is a fact and never a folder level; `institution` is its `role_split` partner and is the eligible half of the pair.

capture_year.meaning: the year a photo or capture was taken, from capture metadata

event.meaning: the named occasion, trip, or gathering a capture or record belongs to

location.meaning: where a capture was taken, resolved from GPS or content

people.meaning: people appearing in a capture; a search/privacy field, seeded as not a folder level

camera_information.meaning: camera make/model/lens metadata; evidence for photo-vs-screenshot, never a folder level

media_type.meaning: what kind of capture this is (photo, screenshot, scan, video); members are values, never roster nodes

repository.meaning: the source repository a code file belongs to, from repo markers

programming_language.meaning: the language of a code file; a search field, seeded as not a folder level

employer.meaning: `employer` is the organization the holder works or worked for, named from the holder's own side

target_employer.meaning: The employer the holder HAS is `employer`; the employer the holder is ADDRESSING is this key.

recruiting_cycle.meaning: the holder is a PARTICIPANT in the cycle. Its `role_split` partner `people_cycle` is the hr side, where the holder runs the cycle.

job_title.meaning: It is the POSITION held, never the person (`subject_of_record`) and never the organization (`employer`, `target_employer`).

organization.meaning: the legal entity or internal unit whose own record this is

record_period.meaning: the bounded interval a record COVERS

supplier.meaning: LABELLED SLOT ONLY -- Carrier / Haulier / Forwarder / Shipping Line / Airline, or the equivalent supplier label on the document.

issuing_body.meaning: The authority that ISSUED the instrument -- a regulator, examining board, licensing authority or certifying body.

property.meaning: a place the record is ABOUT

design_item.meaning: the controlled design configuration whose definition a file governs -- never a saleable or sold article, which is `product`

site.meaning: the operating place -- plant, works, depot, store, field

asset.meaning: An enduring identified physical thing carrying a reference.

product.meaning: an article or formulation made through transformation, widened to a neutral output key

authorization.meaning: The value is the instrument, never a regulator's name

consignment.meaning: One described quantity of goods travelling under one carrier's undertaking -- a THING, the same ontological category as `asset`, not an occurrence.

people_cycle.meaning: the holder RUNS the cycle -- an intake, onboarding or review round the organization operates

subject_of_record.meaning: The person or entity a record is ABOUT, as distinct from its author (`authored_by`), its holder (`our_firm`) and its counterparty (`client`).
